stories.title: Florida Fall Ball 3-0 — USF Coming Tuesday at 6 PM
stories.angle: Florida's fall season is rolling. The Gators are 3-0 and have outscored opponents 62-6 across three lopsided wins: 20-0 vs. Santa Fe (Oct 16), 29-1 vs. Carson-Newman (Oct 17), and 13-5 vs. UNF (Oct 23). Tomorrow night, Florida hosts USF at 6 PM at Katie Seashole Pressly Stadium — free admission. Delaney Edwards has stood out with 3 home runs in the fall. Six starters return from the program's 2026 WCWS run, and the offense looks ready to carry over into the spring.

stories.title: Tennessee Oct 29 Intersquad — 3 Days to See Pickens + Mardjetko Free
stories.angle: Three days until Tennessee's last public event of the fall — the free intersquad Thursday, October 29 at 5 PM ET at Sherri Parker Lee Stadium. This is the final chance to watch Karlyn Pickens (194 K, 1.70 ERA), Sage Mardjetko (16-3, 1.26 ERA), and freshman Bailee Shelton (3 IP, 7 K in fall debut) all pitch in the same afternoon. Coach Karen Weekly has said she wants tougher competition this fall; now she gets a controlled environment to evaluate hitters before winter.

stories.title: 2028 Recruiting — Contact Window Closed, Class Crystallizing
stories.angle: The October 24-25 contact window has closed, and the Class of 2028's top commitments are firming up. Texas leads the national class with Michaela Landers (No. 1 overall IF). Florida's Kylie Holden (No. 2) committed to the Gators earlier this month. OU has Sophia Schlader (No. 3, top pitcher, 70+ mph riseball). Tennessee has added four-star pitcher Megan Kuiper (No. 40) and pitcher Reagan Eldred. The EE100 Pitchers 201-300 rankings are expected tomorrow, Monday Oct 27, and the Top-5 overall reveal is anticipated this week — the biggest recruiting class in history with 1,200+ nominations.

stories.title: Arizona Fall Ball Wraps Up — Shockey Returns, Wildcats Finish Oct 30-31
stories.angle: Arizona softball closes its fall schedule this Thursday-Friday (Oct 30-31) with back-to-back home games at Hillenbrand Stadium. The Wildcats return Big 12 Defensive Player of the Year Regan Shockey and 10 letterwinners from last season's team. With the Big 12 powerhouses — Oklahoma, Texas, Texas Tech, Tennessee — getting all the attention this fall, Arizona is quietly building a 2027 contender.
